accept.name: 整句大写声明（K-a 范围）
accept.source:
MODULE probe.sample.

DEFINE S WITH x AS Int and y AS Text.

Define E AS ONE OF A, B.

USE io.Http VERSION 2 AS H.

RULE get GIVEN s AS S, PRODUCE Int. IT PERFORMS io WITH Http:
  Return s.x.
accept.canonical:
Module probe.sample.

Define S with x as Int and y as Text.

Define E as one of A, B.

Use io.Http version 2 as H.

Rule get given s as S, produce Int. It performs io with Http:
  Return s.x.
